_comment: Family entries: canonical names that are families or aliases, not materials. Reviewed like code.
A material whose Scope is 'Family entry' owns no product. Its members are listed here. It is never
a selection candidate, carries no headline value, estimate or print window of its own, and is
found by search, where it names its members. Until 2026-09-13 these rows held products that
belonged to specific rows, so PA, PA6/66 and CoPA showed one product's numbers three times
(docs/audits/2026-09-13-duplicate-products/). The build fails if a family entry and this file
disagree, if a member is not an in-scope material, or if a family entry owns an active grade.

PA.why: Unfilled aliphatic polyamides. Every product this row held is a PA6/66 copolymer or a PA6, recorded under those rows.

PA-CF.why: Carbon-fibre aliphatic polyamides. Its products were a PA12-CF, a PA612-CF and a PA6-CF, now under those rows.

PA-GF.why: Glass-fibre aliphatic polyamides. Both products it held are PA6-GF, now under that row.

TPE.why: Thermoplastic elastomers. Its products were a TPC (Ultrafuse TPC 45D, also under TPC / TPEE) and a TPU (PolyFlex TPU90, now under TPU).

CoPA.why: Copolyamide. Both products this row held, Polymaker PolyMide CoPA and 3DXTECH AmideX PA6 Copolymer, are nylon 6 and 6,6 copolymers and are recorded under PA6/66.
